tagline: 潘泰康数码单反相机，1969 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1969年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度Focal plane shutter made of steel lamellae, with speeds 1 sec. to 1/1000 sec.。使用35mm with speeds 12 to 1600 ASA。

specs.快门: Focal plane shutter made of steel lamellae, with speeds 1 sec. to 1/1000 sec.
specs.卡口: M42 screw mount with aperture release shifter and electrical contacts for aperture value transmission
specs.取景器: Pentaprism finder, fresnel lens focus screen, in the middle a microprism area, and a triangle that appears when the camera is not cocked for the next shot
specs.闪光灯: shutter flash synchronized up to speed 1/125 sec., bulb flashguns for speed 1/30 sec.; hot shoe
specs.英文简介: The Praktica LLC was made from 1969This is the date in McKeown's however it was reported as a new model in [https://mikeeckman.com/2021/08/kepplers-vault-98-photokina-1970/ press reports from the October 1970 Photokina show] (scans at [https://mikeeckman.com/ MikeEckman.com]), alongside the Olympus FTL.
